messages.subject: Time recording — November narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear fee-earners,

Our records show unposted time for the week commencing 17 November. Please ensure all November time is recorded with proper narratives by 12:00 on Friday 29 November so that bills can be raised before month end. Matters with WIP over £20k should be reviewed for interim billing.

Thank you,
Accounts
